source_refs.note: Book p. 183: 6.3 Parabola, definition (locus; focus; directrix) before 6.3.1.

blocks.text: Bachon, ab tak hum ne circle parha: woh points jo ek fixed point (centre) se barabar door hon. Ab ek naya curve aata hai: parabola. Is ki pehchaan ek point aur ek line dono se hoti hai. Pehle kitab ki definition dekhte hain, phir is ka matlab aasaan alfaaz mein samajhte hain.

Parabola ek aise point ka locus hai jo plane mein is tarah harkat karta hai ke us ka ek fixed point se faasla, jise focus kehte hain, ek di gayi fixed seedhi line se us ke faasle ke barabar rehta hai; is line ko directrix kehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Locus (woh raasta jo ek point kisi shart ko maan kar chalte hue banata hai) ka matlab hai: ek point ghoom raha hai magar har waqt ek rule follow karta hai. Yahan rule yeh hai: focus (fixed point) se faasla = directrix (fixed line) se faasla. Jo bhi point yeh shart poori kare woh parabola par hai, aur parabola ka har point yeh shart poori karta hai.
Symbols mein: agar \(F\) focus hai aur \(P\) se directrix par perpendicular \(PM\) hai, to \(P\) parabola par tab hi hai jab
\[|PF| = |PM|\]
Dhyan dein: line se faasla hamesha perpendicular (sab se chhota) faasla hota hai, tircha nahi.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Socho focus \(F\) ek bijli ka bulb hai aur directrix ek seedhi deewar. Ek chiyunti aisi jagah chalti hai jahan bulb aur deewar dono us se hamesha barabar door rahen. Woh kis shakal ka raasta banayegi? Bulb aur deewar ke bilkul darmiyan ek point zaroor hai (yeh vertex banega), aur jitna chiyunti upar ya neeche jaati hai, utna hi use deewar se door hatna parta hai. Yahi shakal parabola hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Parabola hum roz dekhte hain: hawa mein phenki gayi gend ka raasta, fountain se nikalta pani, suspension bridge ki taar, aur dish antenna ya gaari ki headlight ka cross-section (kaat kar dekhi gayi shakal). Section 6.6 mein kitab parabola ki reflecting property (cheez ko mor kar ek point par jama karne ki khoobi) wale sawal karwati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Focus \(F(1, 0)\) aur directrix \(x = -1\) lein. Kya point \(P(4, 4)\) parabola par hai?
\[|PF| = \sqrt{(4-1)^{2} + (4-0)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{9 + 16} = 5\]
Line \(x = -1\) se \(P\) ka faasla \(|4 - (-1)| = 5\). Dono barabar, is liye \(P\) parabola par hai. Ab point \((1, 1)\) try karein: focus se faasla 1 magar directrix se 2; barabar nahi, is liye yeh parabola par nahi.

Ek baat aur zehan mein bitha lein: is poore section mein har formula isi ek definition se nikalta hai. Agar kabhi exam mein koi formula bhool jayein to ghabrane ki zaroorat nahi; point \(P(x, y)\) lein, focus se faasla aur directrix se faasla likhein, dono ko barabar kar ke square karein, aur equation khud ban jayegi. Exercise 6.3 ke Q2, Q3 aur Q4 bilkul isi tareeqe se hal honge.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Parabola: woh tamaam points jo ek fixed point (focus) aur ek fixed line (directrix) se barabar door hon.
2. Kisi bhi point \(P\) ka test: \(|PF| = |PM|\), jahan \(PM\) directrix tak perpendicular faasla hai.
3. Focus kabhi directrix par nahi hota.
4. Point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) se line \(Ax + By + C = 0\) ka faasla \(\frac{|Ax_{1} + By_{1} + C|}{\sqrt{A^{2} + B^{2}}}\) hai; definition se banne wale har sawal mein yeh formula kaam aata hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Directrix tak faasla tircha naap lena. Hamesha perpendicular faasla lein.
2. Focus ko curve ka point samajhna. Focus curve ke andar (us ke khule hisse ki taraf) hota hai; curve ka focus se sab se qareeb point vertex hai.
3. Circle aur parabola ki definitions mila dena: circle mein ek point se fixed faasla, parabola mein ek point aur ek line se barabar faasla.
